title: Brooke has more opportunities

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: Hey, how you doin'? What you moping around for? The business world waits for no one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, how you doin'? What you moping around for? The business world waits for no one.

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: No one's as busy as me. I'm getting myself into the right grindset. Gotta keep motivated! I just took eight MG of Joos and I'm ready to SELL!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No one's as busy as me. I'm getting myself into the right grindset. Gotta keep motivated! I just took eight MG of Joos and I'm ready to SELL!

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: You ever hear of "passive income"? It's a big deal in the publishing industry right now! I can get you in. Ground FUCKING floor.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You ever hear of "passive income"? It's a big deal in the publishing industry right now! I can get you in. Ground FUCKING floor.

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: Don't worry, anyone can do it! You don't need any special skills. You don't even need money. Not much anyway.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't worry, anyone can do it! You don't need any special skills. You don't even need money. Not much anyway.

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: Yeah! With the discounts we're offering at the moment, this is like giving our one-time purchase instant success programme away for free!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah! With the discounts we're offering at the moment, this is like giving our one-time purchase instant success programme away for free!

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: It's simple! You just get other people to do all the work for you, then you collect all that SWEET profit. Other people do the writing, art, audio description, holo vids - you just put up your feet and let the cash roll in!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's simple! You just get other people to do all the work for you, then you collect all that SWEET profit. Other people do the writing, art, audio description, holo vids - you just put up your feet and let the cash roll in!

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: Suspect? Not at all. Not unless you're one of those... failure chasers. That's right, you can't lose with this programme even if you try. Trust me!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Suspect? Not at all. Not unless you're one of those... failure chasers. That's right, you can't lose with this programme even if you try. Trust me!

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: Sure. I mean just look at me! Do I like a loser or a winner? No, don't answer that. It's obvious.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure. I mean just look at me! Do I like a loser or a winner? No, don't answer that. It's obvious.

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: Yeah! People who WANT to fail. All it takes to succeed is the will to win. Win big!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah! People who WANT to fail. All it takes to succeed is the will to win. Win big!

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: No doubt! Well I'm gonna need some initial investment to start your set up process...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No doubt! Well I'm gonna need some initial investment to start your set up process...

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: I'll call you. There's too many eyes and ears on us now. Gotta keep this on the down low, you hear me? Hang loose business partner.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll call you. There's too many eyes and ears on us now. Gotta keep this on the down low, you hear me? Hang loose business partner.

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: Gotta surround yourself with people who build you up, you know? People who ALWAYS tell you yes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gotta surround yourself with people who build you up, you know? People who ALWAYS tell you yes.

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: Whatever man. I gotta go. I can't manifest with all this negative energy around me. Later, failure!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whatever man. I gotta go. I can't manifest with all this negative energy around me. Later, failure!

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: You will be! And I ain't got time to hang around with negative people. You're an anchor. An anchor! That means you hold people down.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You will be! And I ain't got time to hang around with negative people. You're an anchor. An anchor! That means you hold people down.
